acceptance_criteria: GET /artifact-intake/status reads only FLANGE_QC_V2_ARTIFACT_INTAKE_DIR and does not accept request-supplied paths.
Missing env var returns configured=false, ok=false, readiness flags false, no production authority, and configure_artifact_intake as next task.
Configured env var pointing to a valid metadata bundle returns the existing validator result with configured=true.
HMI renders configured state, shadow model readiness, live camera readiness, next task, warnings/errors, and artifact names/summaries.
Existing /hmi, /inspection/replay, /ws/inspection, feedback, phase results, and product CI behavior continue to work.
Tests prove endpoint and HMI binding behavior, and browser evidence records the panel on /hmi.
